paths.path: ~/.config/jgenesis/jgenesis-config.toml ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/jgenesis/jgenesis-config.toml when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set): one TOML file shared by the GUI and every emulator frontend. A portable.txt file in the emulator directory (the directory holding the AppImage) moves the config to that directory instead. Per-console settings are top-level tables [common], [smsgg], [genesis], [sega_cd], [sega_32x], [nes], [snes], [game_boy], [game_boy_advance], [pc_engine]; controller/input config lives in [input.<console>] of the same file: [input.genesis] has p1_type/p2_type plus mapping_1/mapping_2, each holding p1/p2/p1_turbo/p2_turbo button tables ([input.smsgg] adds pause; [input.hotkeys] maps emulator hotkeys; input.axis_deadzone defaults 8000). Every button value is an array of tagged tables: { type = "Keyboard", key = "X" } (SDL keyname, or "Scancode <name>"), { type = "Gamepad", gamepad_idx = N, action = "Button B" | "Axis A +" | "Hat H Up" }, or { type = "Mouse", button = "Left" }

paths.path: Default common.save_path = RomFolder: the SRAM file sits next to the ROM. common.save_path in jgenesis-config.toml redirects: EmulatorFolder -> <directory containing the AppImage>/saves/<rom extension> (the AppImage path comes from the $APPIMAGE env var on AppImage builds); Custom -> <common.custom_save_path>/<rom extension>, and custom_save_path defaults to ~/.local/share/jgenesis/saves. The <rom extension> subdirectory mirrors the ROM's own extension (game.gen -> saves/gen, game.md -> saves/md, game.smc -> saves/smc)
paths.naming: <ROM file name with its extension replaced by .sav> in the chosen location, e.g. Sonic.sfc -> Sonic.sav; multi-disc ' (Disc N)' suffixes are stripped; zip/7z inputs keep the archive's basename (game.zip -> game.sav). All cartridge cores persist SRAM through the SaveWriter "sav" extension; Sega CD backup RAM also lands in .sav and the 32X RAM cartridge uses .ramc
evidence: source:jgenesis frontend/jgenesis-native-driver/src/mainloop/save.rs determine_path (RomFolder -> rom_path.with_extension("sav") after strip_disc_from_file_name regex ' \(Disc \d\)'; EmulatorFolder -> determine_emulator_dir().join(SAVE_SUBDIR).join(rom_extension); Custom -> custom_path.join(rom_extension)) and determine_save_paths hardcodes "sav" @cbe7f12

paths.path: No BIOS files are required or looked up in a firmware directory: Genesis/32X cartridges, SMS, Game Gear, SG-1000, NES, SNES, and GB/GBC all boot directly into the game. Optional boot ROMs are plain paths in jgenesis-config.toml: [smsgg] sms_boot_from_bios/gg_boot_from_bios (default false) activate sms_bios_path/gg_bios_path; [game_boy] dmg_boot_rom/cgb_boot_rom (default false) activate dmg_boot_rom_path/cgb_boot_rom_path. Sega CD (beyond this record's cart scope) refuses to start without a BIOS from [sega_cd] bios_path/eu_bios_path/jp_bios_path (per_region_bios default true). jgenesis does not emulate Colecovision; its 8-bit Sega coverage is SG-1000/SMS/Game Gear
paths.naming: No external BIOS for ordinary cartridge systems; optional boot ROM paths are explicit config values (sms_bios_path, gg_bios_path, dmg_boot_rom_path, cgb_boot_rom_path, and Sega CD region paths), with no canonical filename/checksum in this source
